# Start-up, restart, bootstrap hold-up, loss of +12 V or the link (generated by m22_startup_failsafe.py)

1. Start-up into discharged output capacitors with the tubes cold (bias clamped: no tube current):
   0 -> 400 V / 390 V through the closed loop (loop_digital.py, both bridges, raw 420 V): the raw
   input current (1 ms average, with 35 mA RAW_SS and the board loss) against the PSU's 1 A, for
   ramp times 30 ms to 200 ms.
2. Restart with charged outputs (after a trip, or HV_ENABLE toggled): the first PWM periods. The
   inductor current excursion if the firmware starts at duty 0 (low side on for the whole period
   minus the dead time: -V_out x t / L) against starting at the feed-forward duty V_out / V_raw
   (the high side is still in UVLO for the first period while its bootstrap charges: the low side
   conducts (1 - D) T only).
3. Bootstrap hold-up: the high side's supply when the low side stops conducting (100 % duty, or
   +12 V lost): 0.8 uF (1 uF X7R at 12 V bias) + 100 nF, drawn by the UCC21520's VDDA (2 mA), the
   10 kohm gate-emitter resistor (1.2 mA at 12 V) and the ES1J's leakage (hot, about 50 uA): time
   from the charged level (M15: 10.9-11.9 V) to the UVLO (8.2 V typ falling, 7.7 V min).
4. +12 V or the link lost while running: a table of the states (no simulation: each is a datasheet
   behaviour of the UCC21520 / ADuM14x / the board's pull-downs), and what the firmware must check.

## 1. Start-up from 0 V, tubes cold (no load)

| ramp 0 -> 400 / 390 V (ms) | raw input peak, 1 ms average (A) | bridge 1 / 2 current peak (A) | V_ANODE tracking error max (V) | within 1 A |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 2.53 | 1.55 / 1.51 | 7.8 | NO |
| 45 | 1.71 | 1.03 / 1.01 | 5.2 | NO |
| 60 | 1.30 | 0.78 / 0.76 | 3.9 | NO |
| 80 | 0.99 | 0.58 / 0.57 | 2.9 | yes |
| 100 | 0.80 | 0.47 / 0.45 | 2.4 | yes |
| 200 | 0.43 | 0.23 / 0.23 | 1.2 | yes |

## 2. Restart with charged outputs: inductor current in the first period

| V_out at restart (V) | start at duty 0: low side on 19.8 us (A) | start at the feed-forward duty V_out / 420 V (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | -0.66 | -0.50 |
| 150 | -0.99 | -0.63 |
| 275 | -1.81 | -0.61 |
| 400 | -2.64 (reverse trip at -2.0 A) | -0.10 |

In the first period the high side is held off by its UVLO until the bootstrap has charged (2.2 ohm x 0.9 uF = 2 us: charged within the first low-side interval); with the feed-forward duty the excursion is small and returns through the high-side diode. **Firmware rule:** start (and restart) the PWM at D = V_out (measured) / V_raw, never at 0 with a charged output; precharge from 0 V with low-side pulses only while V_out < 20 V (the excursion is then < 0.13 A per period).

## 3. Bootstrap hold-up without low-side conduction

| Start (V) | load (mA) | to UVLO 8.2 V typ (ms) | to 7.7 V min (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10.9 | 3.25 | 0.75 | 0.89 |
| 10.9 | 4.5 | 0.54 | 0.64 |
| 11.9 | 3.25 | 1.02 | 1.16 |
| 11.9 | 4.5 | 0.74 | 0.84 |

So 100 % duty holds for about 0.5-1 ms; the high side then stops by itself (UVLO, output low). M15: with positive current the switch node falls to the low-side diode in every dead time and recharges the bootstrap even when the low IGBT gets no pulse, so the duty limit is set by the minimum off time (dead time + about 100 ns), not by the bootstrap: D = 0.99 still gave 10.65 V at +12 V = 11.5 V.

## 4. +12 V or the link lost while running

| Event | What the board does | Outputs | Risk / rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| +12 V falls (isolated supply on the control board fails, pads 39 / 40) | Low side: VDDB below 8.2 V -> UCC21520 output B low (UVLO, per channel); high side runs on its bootstrap, then UVLO within 0.5-1 ms. Input-side dead time / overlap block stays active (VCCI = 3V3): no output overlap through a UVLO edge | fall with the tubes / bleeders (K12 figures) | none; between 9.2 and 8.2 V the gates see 8-9 V: the IGBTs still saturate at these currents |
| 3V3 and +12 V both lost (cable pulled, control board unpowered) | VCCI UVLO, outputs low; 10 kohm gate-emitter resistors hold the gates; fault latch set at power-up; HV_ENABLE 100 kohm pull-down | fall | none (IF-2 fail-safe states) |
| PWM frozen by a firmware / FPGA hang, HV_ENABLE still high | open loop at the last duty: the output drifts to at most D x V_raw = 0.985 x 420 = 414 V as the load falls (BIAS_EN watchdog: bias cold in 130 ms, tubes stop conducting) | V_ANODE <= 414 V, V_SCREEN <= 414 V: **below the 440 / 420 V trips** | no damage (no current with the bias cold); a screen set at 290-360 V can sit at up to 414 V until the HV is removed. Rule: the control board drops HV_ENABLE from its watchdog, not only BIAS_EN |
| Both PWM inputs high (stuck or glitch) | UCC21520 with a DT resistor: both outputs low while both inputs are high | no switching | none |
| ADC link fails (SDO stuck, isolator dead) while the PWM runs | the loop reads 0 V (or full scale) | read 0 V: duty to its limit, output to about 414 V (not tripped); read full scale: duty 0, output falls | **firmware must check the link every conversion**: enable the AD7689 CFG read-back (RB = 0) and compare it, check the returned clock (pad 16), and range-check the raw-rail channel (380-480 V); any failure: HV_ENABLE low |
| HV_PERMIT loop opens | opto off -> DIS high within 100 us (S1 row 7) | fall with the tubes / bleeders | none |
